title: Aggregate size bound for binary conversion
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $cs$ be a list of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables. Suppose that for every circuit $c$ in $cs$, the size of its binary conversion plus one is at most three times its original size. Then the sum of the sizes of the binary conversions of the circuits in $cs$, plus the length of $cs$, is at most three times the sum of their original sizes.
